description: This header defines the 'absl::uniform_real_distribution' class template for generating uniformly distributed floating-point random values over a specified interval. It includes class definitions, methods for parameter handling, and input/output stream operators.

classes.name: absl::uniform_real_distribution
classes.description: A class template for generating floating-point values uniformly distributed over [a, b).

classes.name: absl::uniform_real_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Parameter class for specifying the interval [a, b) for the distribution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random floating-point value using a provided generator and distribution parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the distribution state; has no effect in this implementation.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution interval.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution interval.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.
